page_title: MON 1-3 REI | Monaco v Reims 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Francois Letexier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' 1 - 3 Goal Azor Matusiwa (Reims)! Azor Matusiwa (Reims) was put through by Josh Wilson-Esbrand and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top left corner. 1:3.
90+4' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
90+4' A pass from Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims) is intercepted by Philipp Kohn and the move breaks down.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

89' A through ball from Teddy Teuma (Reims) fails to reach Adama Bojang as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Adama Bojang could have got into a promising position.
88' Yehvann Diouf displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Myron Boadu (Monaco) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
87' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Mohamed Daramy will be replaced by Adama Bojang (Reims).
86' The corner from Teddy Teuma (Reims) is intercepted by the defence.

85' Teddy Teuma (Reims) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Reims have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
84' The resulting free kick from Teddy Teuma (Reims) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
84' Amine Salama (Reims) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
83' Amine Salama (Reims) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
82' The substitution has been made. Antonin Cartillier (Monaco) has replaced Kassoum Ouattara.
82' Vanderson (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.

81' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
80' Joseph Okumu (Reims) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
78' That will be all from Reda Khadra who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims).
76' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is penalised for a foul. Francois Letexier had a clear view and blows his whistle.

75' What a poor attempt! Amine Salama (Reims) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
72' A substitution has been made. Youssouf Fofana is replaced by Myron Boadu (Monaco).
71' Teddy Teuma (Reims) swings in a cross from the corner, but Philipp Kohn reads it well and gathers the ball.

70' A terrific piece of skill by Mohamed Daramy (Reims) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten. Reims will take a corner kick.
69' Monaco fail to score from a corner as Yehvann Diouf (Reims) leaps to collect the ball.

69' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Yehvann Diouf displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee blows his whistle, Monaco are awarded a corner kick.

68' Good touch by Mohamed Daramy (Reims) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.

66' Reda Khadra (Reims) unleashes a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Philipp Kohn thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
64' Monaco are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
62' Thibault De Smet (Reims) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
62' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) sent a pass onto Teddy Teuma, who didn't get a chance to finish.
61' Teddy Teuma (Reims) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. It's a throw-in for Reims.
61' Reims work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
57' The game has come to an end for Mamadou Diakhon. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Amine Salama (Reims).

55' 1 - 2 Reda Khadra (Reims) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Philipp Kohn is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:2.
54' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) is adjudged offside.
49' 1 - 1 Goal! Aleksandr Golovin swings the ball deep into the box and finds Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
47' Reims take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
46' Will Still makes a half-time substitution. Amadou Kone comes on in place of Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) comes off for Folarin Balogun.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' A pass into the penalty area from Mohamed Daramy (Reims) is intercepted by the defence.
44' Vanderson (Monaco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner but it's cleared.

40' Teddy Teuma (Reims) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance. The ball goes out of play. Reims are awarded a corner kick.

39' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.

38' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Monaco are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Daramy slips it to Teddy Teuma (Reims) on the edge of the box and he finds the top left corner with a great effort. The score is 0:1.
34' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
32' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
30' The ball is cleared after Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
28' Some great controlled play and passing from Reims. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
23' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

23' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf reacts superbly to deny him. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

19' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
18' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

17' Yehvann Diouf pulls off a great save to deny Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Monaco win a corner.
12' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francois Letexier saw the whole situation.
11' Teddy Teuma (Reims) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
9' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
4' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' Monaco take a short corner kick.

2' A precise low pass is received by Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier will referee today's match.
